name: Oi kuntani mun
source:
In 2006, the city of Helsinki sought to expand its area by annexing parts of surrounding municipalities – in particular the rural Sipoo, located east – to address increasing demand for low-density housing.

This is that story.

[From [url=https://purkka.itch.io/my-municipality]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
2006年，赫尔辛基市寻求通过吞并部分周边城市（特别是位于东部的Sipoo乡村）来扩大其面积，以满足对低密度住房日益增长的需求。

这就是那个故事。

[来自[url=https://purkka.itch.io/my-municipality]Itch.io[/url]]
